records.method: built-in image_gen; whole-object edit, no procedural dirt overlay, slicing, compositing, or pixel postprocessing
records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one complete transparent PNG collectible for a refined 2.5D pixel-art portrait H5 game.
Edit target / identity reference: the supplied tape-stabilized.png. Supporting style reference: approved 03_curio_restoration_and_collection.png only; do not reproduce its layout or other objects.
Primary request: create the CLEAN BUT STILL BROKEN state of exactly this purple-and-gold desktop tape dispenser. Re-render the complete intact single object, maintaining the same three-quarter angle, warm ivory tape roll, copper hub, continuous purple side plates with golden scuffed edges, small round brass fasteners, footprint, silhouette scale and warm top-left lighting of the reference.
Mechanical state must be visibly UNREPAIRED: the one connected tape strip extending from the roll to the front has a clearly curled upward end and is skewed/misaligned relative to its front guide, with one buckled fold in the free tape span. The whole strip stays visibly connected to the roll. Do not add detached tape scraps or a pile of paper. The dispenser body is one coherent object and all original parts stay installed.
Cleaning state: tape surfaces and housing are clean and free from mud, dust, fibers, and grime. Retain normal age scratches and chipped gold edging. The bent/skewed tape is NOT repaired by cleaning.
Style: finely detailed high-density pixel art, small crisp pixel clusters, 2.5D volume with nuanced material shading; warm cream/gold highlights, copper hub, rich purple enamel, restrained rim light. Match the original asset's pixel scale and polished quality, not coarse low-resolution blocks or smooth photographic painting.
Composition: square canvas, full object centered, identical viewing angle to target, about 12% truly empty transparent margin around the subject; no cropping. Transparent alpha background, no floor, cast shadow on a floor, scene, tools, cabinet, letters, captions, watermark, sparkles, floating pieces, or extra objects. Preserve transparency. Output exactly one complete dispenser, not a comparison sheet.

records.method: built-in image_gen; single whole-object edit; unmodified PNG output, no compositing or pixel postprocessing
records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: complete transparent full-object collectible PNG for a fine 2.5D pixel-art game, found-state A2.
Exact edit target: supplied tape-found.png. Make ONE narrowly targeted material edit to the same complete purple-and-gold tape dispenser.
LOCK every structural feature and preserve the entire illustration: identical object placement/scale/canvas, three-quarter camera, purple fixed frame, gold scuffs and scratches, cream roll and copper hub, all screws and fasteners, existing lighting and pixel density. The connected tape strip must keep EXACTLY its existing curve, fold, skew, length, attached path, and upcurled tip. No geometry changes, no repair, no additional component.
Change only dirt on the exposed adhesive tape: strengthen the existing adhesive lint into a clearly readable but natural contiguous GRAY PAPER-FIBER AND DUST buildup covering approximately ONE THIRD of the visible tape surface, concentrated on the lower hanging tape span and curled tip. Make it visible even when this object is displayed at 384 pixels: a muted medium-gray thin sticky lint coating with intertwined tiny gray paper fibers and fine flecks following the tape's curved surface, not merely a handful of nearly invisible hair strands. Use irregular naturally adhered coverage, with some cream tape exposed between fibers and the remaining two thirds of tape clean/readable. The tape still has its original thin silhouette; buildup is a surface film, never a thick mass. Match the established warm light and pixel-art material shading.
Do not add dirt to the roll circumference, copper hub, purple frame or gold trim beyond what already exists. Do not cover the whole tape and do not create a uniform overlay. No mud, brown clumps, torn paper scraps, crumpled paper ball, debris pile, floating fibers away from the tape, detached strips, or unexplained extra objects.
Preserve the same refined small crisp pixel clusters, warm cream/gold and purple palette, original alpha transparency and empty margins. Output ONE COMPLETE OBJECT PNG on a genuinely transparent background. No floor, scene, tools, cabinet, text, watermark, glow or split panels. No compositing or isolated stain layer.
